cues.en: and I just kept telling him no, no, I'm not taking investment. Basically I had nothing for him to invest in
cues.zh: 但我一直拒绝他，说不不不，我不接受投资。其实我根本没什么好让他投的，

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 然后

cues.en: but then you know when that AOL thing was happening, we're trying to get it done, I tried to pull him into it etcetera. He put in about a million bucks.
cues.zh: 但后来 AOL 出事的时候，我们想把交易敲定，我就试着把他拉进来。他投了大概一百万美元。

cues.en: 300,000 of which paid off those chaos dudes.
cues.zh: 其中 30 万把那帮捣乱的家伙买断打发了。

cues.en: But basically remember, so my customers were like News Corp,
cues.zh: 但基本上要记住，我的客户包括 News Corp，

cues.en: Viacom,
cues.zh: Viacom，

cues.en: like big telecom companies
cues.zh: 以及大型电信公司这样的巨头，

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 而

cues.en: there we go.
cues.zh: 搞定了。

cues.en: And I had no engineers. Now I'm an engineer by training but Jesus, like it's been a long time since I coded and it was meaningful.
cues.zh: 可我手下根本没有工程师。我自己虽是学工程出身的，但天哪，我已经很久没正经写过能用的代码了。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: I call... I basically had this deal with the engineer. He was a quirky guy. I could only get his
cues.zh: 我联系……我基本上和一个工程师达成了协议。他性格古怪，我只能在

cues.en: his help
cues.zh: 求他帮忙，

cues.en: after 10PM on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
cues.zh: 周二和周四晚上 10 点以后。

cues.en: So I call him and basically be like hands and knees like, so do you think you can...
cues.zh: 所以我给他打电话，基本上就是低三下四地求他：你看你能不能……

cues.en: And it was really painful.
cues.zh: 那段日子真的很痛苦。

cues.en: So now we're already to 2,006
cues.zh: 转眼就到了 2006 年，

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: basically I'm really starting to get what I call swoosh hairs. This is like the white hairs you see right here. And
cues.zh: 基本上我开始长出我所谓的“飞线白发”了。就是你们现在看到的这些白发。于是

cues.en: I just had to do something fun and so I did something which we called offshoring ourselves
cues.zh: 我必须找点乐子，所以做了一件我们称之为“把自己离岸外包”的事，

cues.en: which is
cues.zh: 也就是

cues.en: we would always talk about, hey, we're just coders.
cues.zh: 我们总会念叨：嘿，我们不过就是写代码的。

cues.en: Why don't we go to some exotic island
cues.zh: 我们为什么不去某个异域海岛

cues.en: and code from there? You know, why not? Right? Jet skis and like girls in bikinis, it'll be amazing.
cues.zh: 在哪儿写代码呢？为什么不呢？骑骑摩托艇，看比基尼妹子，简直爽翻了。

cues.en: And then our lease ran out on our office space and we said shit, let's just do it. And so we've three days, you know, we've... That night, we went to Mel's Diner in San Francisco. Everybody threw a location in the hat and we ended up like three days later, we're on a flight to Thailand.
cues.zh: 接着我们办公室租约到期了，我们心想去他的，直接干吧。那天晚上我们去了旧金山的 Mel's Diner。每个人把一个地点写下来扔进帽子里抽签，结果三天后，我们已经在飞往泰国的航班上了。

cues.en: And we ultimately worked there for two months
cues.zh: 最终我们在那儿工作了两个月

cues.en: from the beach. One of the most beautiful beaches in the world. It was great.
cues.zh: 就在海滩边办公。全世界最漂亮的海滩之一，真的很棒。

cues.en: Great way to have fun while you're failing.
cues.zh: 创业失败时苦中作乐的绝佳方式。

cues.en: So by November of o six, basically I was running out of money again
cues.zh: 到了 06 年 11 月，我基本上又快弹尽粮绝了

cues.en: and we were in discussions
cues.zh: 当时我们正在谈

cues.en: with EchoStar which is Dish TV for another million dollar a year type revenue deal. Deal was ready to go, they were ready to sign, the whole nine
cues.zh: 和 EchoStar（也就是 Dish TV）谈一笔年营收百万美元级的单子。万事俱备，他们都准备签字了，一切就绪

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 然而

cues.en: Mark,
cues.zh: Mark，

cues.en: the board was me and Mark Cuban. He he was kinda done with the business. He was just not interested anymore
cues.zh: 董事会就我和 Mark Cuban 两人。他差不多对这门生意感到厌倦了，彻底没了兴趣

cues.en: And maybe it was my offshoring extravaganza
cues.zh: 也许是我那次海岛办公的荒唐狂欢

cues.en: that sort of
cues.zh: 在某种程度上

cues.en: upset him a little bit. I I still don't totally know.
cues.zh: 让他有点不爽。我到现在其实也说不太准。

cues.en: But we got to an impasse. Now,
cues.zh: 但我们陷入了僵局。于是，

cues.en: goodbye him. He basically said, look I'm out. You can go have... You can go figure out a way to get money or get me bought out like it cost.
cues.zh: 他要散伙了。他基本上说：听着，我不玩了。你可以去……你可以自己想办法弄钱，或者按原价把我的股份买断。

cues.en: So basically I called all the VCs that had ever tried to hit me up who I said, oh we're not taking investment. Said look, I need to do a partner meeting next Monday.
cues.zh: 于是我给所有之前主动联系过我、却被我说“我们不拿投资”拒掉的 VC 打了个遍。我说：听着，我下周一得参加合伙人会议。

cues.en: Let's go.
cues.zh: 我们开始吧。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: pitch them all basically on the vision and said look, here here's here's the catch. My largest investor
cues.zh: 基本上都是基于愿景去说服他们，我说，你看，情况是这样的。我最大的投资人

cues.en: wants out.
cues.zh: 想退出。

cues.en: This always works at VC meetings.
cues.zh: 这招在风投会议上总是奏效。

cues.en: I said,
cues.zh: 我说，

cues.en: I have an option to buy his stock at cost.
cues.zh: 我有权按成本价买下他的股份。

cues.en: Simultaneous with you buying that option,
cues.zh: 在你们买下这个选项的同时，

cues.en: I'm going to sign a deal with EchoStar for a million dollars a year in revenue.
cues.zh: 我会和EchoStar签一份每年一百万美元收入的协议。

cues.en: And our valuation will then multiply instantaneously
cues.zh: 然后我们的估值就会瞬间翻倍

cues.en: like five x or 10 x or something like this.
cues.zh: 大概五倍、十倍之类的。

cues.en: And that night,
cues.zh: 那天晚上，

cues.en: VC at Crosslink, I named Jim Foy said let's do it.
cues.zh: Crosslink的风投，我叫他Jim Foy，说干吧。

cues.en: And so it was the craziest deal I've ever seen because it was a four way deal. It was me,
cues.zh: 所以那是我见过最疯狂的交易，因为它是四方交易。有我，

cues.en: it was Mark Cuban,
cues.zh: 有Mark Cuban，

cues.en: it was new VC,
cues.zh: 有新来的风投，

cues.en: and it was EchoStar and all those deals had to be done at the same time. Almost lost my mind.
cues.zh: 还有EchoStar，所有这些交易必须同时完成。我差点疯了。

cues.en: Oh, and I told Mark, I said look,
cues.zh: 哦，我跟Mark说，我说你看，

cues.en: Akamai is liking our stuff. I was having a discussion with them. I think they're gonna acquire us. I think they're gonna freaking acquire us. Just hang in there man.
cues.zh: Akamai很喜欢我们的东西。我当时在跟他们谈。我觉得他们要收购我们了。我觉得他们真的要收购我们了。兄弟，再撑一撑。

cues.en: And it
cues.zh: 然后它

cues.en: was just you know, was just done.
cues.zh: 就那么成了。

cues.en: But in April 2007, Akamai acquired us.
cues.zh: 但在2007年4月，Akamai收购了我们。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: the deal was... So at that point, I think I had like, we built our team back up. We were like six or seven people at that point.
cues.zh: 那笔交易是……那时候，我记得我们已经把团队重新建起来了。当时大概有六七个人。

cues.en: Maybe 10. Something like that. And
cues.zh: 也许十个。差不多这样。然后

cues.en: they bought us all in for about $23,000,000.
cues.zh: 他们把我们整体收购了，大约2300万美元。

cues.en: So that's my application for non luckiest entrepreneur of the year. And that's it. Thank you.
cues.zh: 这就是我竞选年度最倒霉创业者的申请材料。就这些。谢谢。
